Inspiring interview from @teslaownersSV  with Neuralink Patient 24 @SCI_Borg24 : ventilator-dependent quadriplegic who fell from a ladder in 2020, coded for four minutes, and now controls a cursor with his mind just one month after implant surgery. His wife’s relentless advocacy got him into the trial. Strong Christian faith (like Patient 1 @ModdedQuad ) fuels his hope — viewing Neuralink as a gift from God and aiming to glorify Him through restored independence (wheelchair control, Optimus, Revit drafting, less caregiver burden). Early wins already showing. Faith + frontier tech = real hope for BCI patients. piped.video/2DuwUhan4lY

🌍 Starlink is transforming education in Malawi.

Over 100,000 students and 1,500 teachers across 30 rural schools now have access to reliable internet through Starlink. For many communities, it's the first time students, teachers, and families can connect to online learning resources, unlocking new opportunities for education and growth. 

The digital divide is shrinking one connection at a time.
